value.rationale: This completely determines intrinsic abstract (anti-)automorphism and cross-rank isomorphism structures for a natural Bell-number-sized family of finite monoids. It reconstructs both the minimal generating letters and their order solely from multiplication, proving that the already known evacuation involution exhausts all reversing symmetries. It is a motivated natural full classification despite the short proof, and it explicitly avoids claiming a new construction of evacuation or new presentation.
